notes.title: Jesus Christ, our Lord and Savior
notes.content:
In the name of Jesus Christ, I receive the power of God to preach the irresistible gospel. I also claim the strength and grace of God to preach the gospel that will lead sinners to repentance and have access to the kingdom of God. Let the Holy Spirit come upon me, and let him empower me to do exploits for his kingdom. For in the name of Jesus Christ I make my declarations.

This new update is thanks to the grace and blessing of Jesus Christ’s most venerable name. The update features new added scenes that recreate events from the Bible meant to express its divinity onto the world. Follow in Christ’s footsteps and relive his memory through the agony in the garden to the stations of the cross. Every man, woman, and child is to follow in the parables and gospels that are contained within these sacred texts and follow in Christ’s loving mercy.

Accompanying cutscenes and new music have been added to better exemplify the charm and dignity of humanity that lies within the sanctity of life that God has gifted us all in this world of his creation. Praise be his name and let us all bathe in his merciful judgement, as every human and creature of his is entitled to. Praise be those who follow in his name. May sinners reap what they sow, for those who turn away will leave their inheritance from God’s ever-present love.

A new Mac and translations versions will come in due time, for God’s grace shall shine onto my own, and commit towards that goal of preaching the good word of the Lord.

Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be satisfied. Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

Hail Mary, Full of Grace, The Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners now, and at the hour of our death.

And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
